name: Queen (Belshazzar's mother or wife)
title: The Wise Queen of Babylon
summary: The queen who appeared during Belshazzar's feast when the mysterious writing appeared on the wall. She remembered the prophet Daniel and his wisdom from Nebuchadnezzar's time, and recommended that he be summoned to interpret the writing. Her advice led to Daniel being brought in to explain God's judgment against the Babylonian empire.

keyEvents.title: The Queen Enters the Banquet Hall
keyEvents.description: When Belshazzar and his nobles were confused by the writing on the wall, the queen entered the banquet hall because of the commotion and offered her help.

keyEvents.title: The Queen Reminds Them of Daniel
keyEvents.description: She told the king about a man in the kingdom who had the spirit of the gods within him, whom Nebuchadnezzar had appointed as head of the wise men because of his extraordinary wisdom.

keyEvents.title: Recommendation to Summon Daniel
keyEvents.description: The queen advised Belshazzar to summon Daniel, who could interpret dreams, solve riddles, and explain what was hidden. This advice was followed.
